verdict.rationale: RudderStack's docs describe an 'open source version' backed only by PostgreSQL (rudderstack-docs-20/32/58/71), implying open licensing, but community discussion explicitly notes the project moved from AGPLv3/SSPL to the Elastic License (rudderstack-comm-6, rudderstack-comm-7), which is a source-available, non-OSI-approved license restricting commercial redistribution — contradicting a genuinely 'open license' claim. Missing for 10: a first-party license file/page confirming current terms, clarity on which components remain AGPL vs Elastic, and independent confirmation of what freedoms the current license actually grants.
